definitions.explanation: A house that is not occupied.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{家|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

{空|あ}き{家|や}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a vacant house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空|あ}き{家|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
{空|あ}き{家|や} refers to a house with no one living in it.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {空|あ}き{家|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ (vacant houses increase)
- {空|あ}き{家|や}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用：01752_riyou⟧ (use a vacant house)
- {空|あ}き{家|や}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (vacant house problem)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空|あ}き{地|ち}→空き地：15270_akichi⟧: vacant lot
- {空|あ}き{室|しつ}: vacant room
- ⟦{空|あ}き{缶|かん}→空き缶：23052_akikan⟧: empty can

Note: {空|あ}き{家|や} has become a social issue in Japan due to aging population and rural depopulation.
